description.value:
Duration constant

Held Open's window lasts 1 additional round. Everything else about it is unchanged — the same once-per-encounter frequency, the same ally, the same reach. The gate simply takes a beat longer to reseal.

cinderfall.incomplete: Ashcantor's entire signature resource system (Passage, a Passing, Walking Through, Embers, Ash-Light) has zero rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus -- the class card itself (classes.ashcantor.json) ships system.rules: [], and no abilities/ or class-features/ card exists to hold a Passage/Ember mechanic either. Checked pf2e's own generic SpecialResource rule element (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/special-resource.ts:24-247) as a possible fit: every real user (Alchemist's Versatile Vials, Gunslinger's Munitions Machinist, Fumbus's iconic feats) is a daily-refilling consumable counter, never a one-way permanent-increase track like Passage -- no real class resource matches Passage's shape, so there is no base mechanic here to extend or modify. This is a child of "Held Open," granted by The Threshold (ashcantor.the-threshold.json), whose own system.rules is [] -- Held Open has no duration or frequency field to extend by 1 round.
